full_prompt_en: A square fantasy anime illustration shows a blue-haired maid standing among dense trees at night, with a large luminous moon behind her head. The background is a layered woodland of teal-blue foliage and small scattered points of light. Warm amber leaves enter from the upper left and along the left edge, while a few loose leaves drift across the darker right side. The moon forms a bright pale-blue disk near the upper center, partly hidden by her head and the overhanging branches. The young woman stands slightly left of center, visible from mid-thigh upward and turned three-quarters toward the right. Her short ice-blue hair falls across one eye, and a small decorative hairpiece rests along the side of her head. The visible blue eye gazes calmly into the distance, her pale face softly shaded by moonlight. She wears a black-and-white maid outfit with a high frilled neckline, puffed white shoulder ruffles, fitted dark bodice, long dark sleeves, and a white apron bordered by dark piping. Narrow pale fasteners run vertically down the front, and the skirt ends in a soft ruffle near the lower edge. One hand hangs relaxed at her side. The figure is outlined clearly against the busy forest, while the foliage dissolves into softly painted light and shadow. Cool light from behind and above rims the hair, shoulders, and apron, and faint blue glints catch leaves and undergrowth. The near foreground is darker and less defined; no readable text appears. The overall composition is quiet and enchanted, setting precise costume and face detail against a softly glowing nocturnal atmosphere with restrained amber accents.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形奇幻动漫插画呈现一位蓝发女仆夜晚站在密林之中，头后是一轮硕大而发亮的月亮。背景是层叠青蓝色树叶和散落小光点组成的树林。暖琥珀色叶片从左上及左边缘伸入，右侧较暗区域有几片叶子飘动。月亮在上部中央附近形成明亮淡蓝圆盘，部分被她的头和上方枝叶遮住。年轻女子站在中央偏左，从大腿中部向上入画，身体朝右转成四分之三侧面。冰蓝色短发盖住一只眼睛，头侧有小小装饰发饰。可见的蓝眼睛平静望向远处，浅色面庞在月光下柔和塑形。她穿黑白女仆装，有高高的褶边领口、蓬起的白色肩部花边、贴身深色上衣、深色长袖，以及镶深色滚边的白围裙。前襟一列狭窄浅色扣饰竖向排列，裙摆在下缘附近以柔软花边收尾。一只手放松地垂在身旁。人物在繁密树林前保持清楚轮廓，枝叶则溶入柔和绘制的光影。后上方的冷光给头发、肩膀和围裙镶边，微弱蓝色光点落在叶片与灌木上。近处前景更暗也更不明确；没有可读文字。整体构图安静而迷人，让精确服装与面部细节衬在柔和发光的夜间空气前，并有克制的琥珀色点缀。
style_prompt_en: The fantasy anime style combines fine, clean focal linework with a softer, densely layered luminous environment. Deep indigo, teal, and cyan form the main range, while isolated amber shapes keep the cool palette from becoming uniform. A large diffused backlight creates a pale halo and cool rim light, separating a clear dark-and-light silhouette from complicated surrounding texture. Focal surfaces have crisp trims, small fasteners, and smooth shading; background forms break into feathery strokes, soft bokeh, and glowing specks. Dark foreground passages give depth by partially veiling the lower frame. Light falls gently across raised edges, while recesses stay blue-violet rather than neutral black. The composition places a vertical central mass before a brighter circular area and lets irregular detail gather toward the margins. The overall effect is still, magical, and slightly melancholic, using focus and luminous cool color to balance detail with atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 这种奇幻动漫画风把细致干净的焦点线描与较柔和、层叠密集且发亮的环境结合。深靛蓝、青绿和青蓝构成主色域，少数琥珀色形状避免冷色配色显得单一。一片大型漫射逆光形成浅色光晕与冷色轮廓光，将清楚的深浅剪影从复杂周围肌理中分离出来。焦点表面有清晰的镶边、细小扣饰和平滑塑形；背景形体碎成羽毛状笔触、柔软散景与发光小点。深色前景段落通过部分遮住下方画幅建立纵深。光轻轻落在凸起边缘，凹处保留蓝紫色，而非中性黑。构图把竖向中央大形放在较亮圆形区域前，让不规则细节聚集在周缘。整体效果静止、奇幻且略带忧伤，用聚焦和发光的冷色在细节与空气感之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A blue-haired maid standing in a moonlit forest
theme_zh: 蓝发女仆立于月光下的树林
name: ReZero
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
